risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively detailed and includes substantial acreage, financing, exploration, and impairment figures, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and uncertain exploration outcomes. Material risks include dependence on commodity prices, permitting and regulatory changes, financing needs, environmental closure obligations, and significant asset-impairment exposure.
